description: This file defines the interface for rtConnection objects, including creation, destruction, message sending (both via structured messages and binary payloads), listener management, and connection state handling. It provides the API for managing RT messages over a connection in a C environment.

methods.name: rtConnection_Create
methods.description: Creates a new rtConnection object with specified application name and router configuration.

methods.name: rtConnection_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys an existing rtConnection object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a structured message over the connection to a specified topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendMessageDirect
methods.description: Sends a structured message directly to a specific listener on a topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message and waits for a response within a specified timeout.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response to a request, identified by the request header.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinary
methods.description: Sends a binary payload over the connection to a topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryDirect
methods.description: Sends binary payload directly to a specific listener on a topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryRequest
methods.description: Sends a binary request and receives a binary response within a timeout.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryResponse
methods.description: Sends a binary response to a request identified by the request header.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddListener
methods.description: Registers a callback function to listen for messages matching an expression.

methods.name: rtConnection_RemoveListener
methods.description: Removes a message listener matching an expression.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddAlias
methods.description: Adds an alias to an existing listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_RemoveAlias
methods.description: Removes an alias from an existing listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddDefaultListener
methods.description: Registers a default callback for all message receipts.

methods.name: rtConnection_GetReturnAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the return address of the current connection.

methods.name: rtConnection_Dispatch
methods.description: Processes incoming messages; note that this method is marked as legacy in the comment.

ctags.name: rtMessageCallback
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*rtMessageCallback)(rtMessageHeader const* hdr, uint8_t const* buff, uint32_t n, v/
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(rtMessageHeader const * hdr,uint8_t const * buff,uint32_t n,void * closure)
